q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
**3 days** — NVIDIA will release Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close. This is an extremely short timeframe where the outcome is largely determined.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research clearly states that **NVIDIA has already issued forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 of $91.0 billion (±2%)**, announced on May 20, 2026. This guidance was issued after Q1 results and represents management's official outlook for the quarter ending July 28, 2026.

The question asks what NVIDIA's forward guidance will be in its Q2 earnings release — meaning guidance for *Q3 FY2027* (the subsequent quarter). However, I must work with what's given.

If the question is asking about the Q2 guidance already issued ($91.0B ±2%), the answer is deterministic: **$91.0 billion**.

If the question is asking about forward guidance issued *during* the Q2 earnings call (guidance for Q3), that would be speculative and hasn't occurred yet (as of August 23, 2026).

Given the phrasing "in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release," the most reasonable interpretation is that it refers to the forward guidance that will be provided during the Q2 earnings event itself — which typically includes guidance for the next quarter (Q3 FY2027).

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Demand weakening signals**: Any indication that the AI chip super-cycle is slowing
- **China revenue constraints**: Geopolitical export restrictions could reduce addressable market
- **Competitive pressures**: Increased competition from AMD, Intel, or custom silicon from cloud providers
- **Macro slowdown**: Recessionary concerns reducing enterprise capex
- **Guidance conservatism**: Management deliberately guiding lower after beating Q2 expectations

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Demand acceleration**: Stronger-than-expected AI infrastructure spending from hyperscalers
- **Supply confidence**: Ability to produce more chips than previously anticipated
- **Price stability or increases**: ASPs remaining elevated or increasing further
- **China opportunities**: Potential relaxation of export restrictions
- **Beat & raise pattern**: Q2 actual results exceeding guidance, supporting aggressive Q3 outlook
- **Market momentum**: Analyst sentiment and stock performance indicating confidence

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- **Q1 FY2027 revenue**: $81.6B (actual)
- **Q2 FY2027 guidance**: $91.0B ±2% (already issued; range: $89.18B – $92.82B)
- **Sequential growth Q1→Q2**: ~11.4% implied by the $91.0B guidance against $81.6B actual Q1
- **Wall Street consensus for Q2**: $91.9B (within NVIDIA's guided range)
- **Recent trajectory**: 85% YoY growth, 20% sequential growth in Q1; guidance suggests ~11-12% sequential for Q2

NVIDIA has shown a pattern of strong execution and often beats guidance. The company's guidance for $91.0B suggests confidence but also built-in conservatism (guidance typically ranges ±2%).

## Key interpretive issue

The question asks for "forward guidance in Q2 FY2027 earnings release" — the phrase is ambiguous:
- If it means guidance already issued: $91.0B is the answer
- If it means new guidance issued during the Q2 call (for Q3): This hasn't happened yet

The range provided (99.5–115.5B) is **well above** the $91.0B already guided. This suggests the question is asking for guidance on a *later* quarter, or guidance NVIDIA will issue during the August 26 earnings call for Q3 FY2027.

Given NVIDIA's trajectory (85% YoY growth, 20% sequential in Q1, ~11% sequential implied for Q2), and assuming similar sequential growth rates, Q3 guidance would plausibly fall into the 100-115B range.

## Probability distribution for Q3 FY2027 guidance (to be issued Aug 26)

Assuming ~10-12% sequential growth from implied Q2 actual of ~$91-92B:
- Expected Q3 guidance: **~100-105B**

The range 99.5–115.5B spans reasonable outcomes. My distribution:

Low (10th percentile): 97000000000
Median (50th percentile): 103000000000
High (90th percentile): 112000000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion for Q1 FY2027 (ended April 26, 2026), an 85% increase year-over-year and 20% sequentially. Data Center revenue reached a record $75.2 billion, up 92% year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, projects revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Wall Street analysts' average estimate for Q2 revenue is $91.9 billion, within NVIDIA's guided range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). NVIDIA is set to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).
